verdict.rationale: The only route to AI-driven insight from data is the official CockroachDB Cloud MCP server, which lets your own external AI tools explore live schemas and run natural-language read/write queries against clusters. That means insights come from a separate AI client rather than being generated inside the product, and vector indexes are only building blocks for your own AI apps. Missing for 10: built-in AI assistant in the console or SQL shell, product-generated insights or suggestions on user data, independent or hands-on corroboration.
